summary: On August 7, 2026, JIADE Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of director and Joint-CEO Xiaohui Li, effective the same day, for personal reasons with no disagreement with the company. The board appointed Kunqi Bai to fill the vacancy; Bai previously served as a director from May 2024 to January 2025 and currently manages day-to-day operations at a subsidiary. No financial terms, advisors, or recommendations were disclosed. The departure of a joint CEO is an abrupt leadership change, though the replacement was immediate. Watch for further management stability signals or potential strategic shifts.
